_comment: The add-on's name, in ONE place. tools/build.ps1 names the staged add-on folder, the TOC, Bindings.xml, the SavedVariables and the release zips after `name`, and writes `slash` into Config/Brand.lua. Lua code derives every global from the folder name at runtime (Core/Init.lua). To rename: tools/build.ps1 rename <NewName> [<slash>]. Players' saved settings are stored under <name>DB, so renaming after a release starts them fresh.
